traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.text: The elemental dragon’s innate spellcasting is Charisma (spell save DC 18, +10 to hit with spell attacks). It can cast the following spell requiring no material components. * At will: gust of wind * 3/day each: call lightning, wind wall * 1/day each: control weather, plane shift

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/day)
traits.text:
If the dragon fails a saving
throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text:
The dragon makes three attacks: one with its bite and two
with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 19
(2d10 + 8) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15
(2d6 + 8) slashing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 17
(2d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Scalding Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.text:
The dragon releases a 60-foot cone of
superheated air that wraps around corners. Creatures within the area must
make a DC 21 Constitution saving throw, taking 63 (18d6) fire damage on
a failed saving throw, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Whirlwind (Recharge 5–6)
actions.text:
The dragon creates a cyclone in a 30-
foot radius centered on itself. Creatures, other than the dragon, within
the area can only move half their normal movement, nonmagical ranged
attacks automatically fail, and all nonmagical unprotected flames are
automatically extinguished. Large or smaller creatures within the area
must also succeed on a DC 21 Strength saving throw. On a failed saving
throw, the creature takes 20 (3d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage and is knocked
prone and pushed 30 in a random direction. On a successful saving throw,
the creature takes half damage and is not otherwise affected.
